blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq waxes acylglycerols se bante (derived) hain. In mein carbon atoms bohat zyada hone ki wajah se in ka melting point zyada hai, is liye yeh room temperature par solid hote hain. Chemically waxes ki koi tay shuda structure aur composition nahin; yeh lambi zanjeer wale alkanes (jin mein carbon taaq (odd) tadaad mein, 25 se 35 tak), alcohols (glycerol ke ilawa), ketones aur lambi zanjeer wale fatty acids ka mixture hain.
Shehad ki makkhiyan wax banati hain aur is se apne chhatte ke chhe kone wale (hexagonal) khane banati hain jin mein shehad jama hota hai. Insanon mein bahari kaan ki nali ke glands wax banate hain.

Waxes chemically inert hain (aasani se react nahin karte). Doosre lipids ki tarah waxes bhi bohat hydrophobic (pani se door rehne wale) hain, is liye yeh jandaron ke liye hifazati ghilaf aur pani ki rukawat (water barrier) ka kaam karte hain. Phalon aur patton par wax ki hifazati teh aam hai. Kuch janwar, jaise keere, parinde aur bher waghaira, bhi apni jild par wax nikalte hain.

Waxes kaghaz aur cards ko waterproof banane mein istemal hote hain. Furniture, jooton aur gariyon ki wax polish mein bhi, aur mom-battiyan (candles) banane mein bhi. Rangdar pigments mila kar waxes se crayons aur rangdar pencils banaye jate hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar tasveerein saath saath, kitab ki tasveeron ke mutabiq, har ek ke neeche label: chamakdar gehre hare patte (Wax on cuticle of leaves); andheri pas-manzar par do jalti narangi mombattiyan (Candles made of wax); rangeen wax crayons ka khula dabba (Wax crayons); lakdi par peeli wax polish ki khuli gol dibbi (Waxy polish).
